name: Crazy Fruit Factory
summary:
Get ready for some crazy fruit slicing action in VR! Step into the wacky world of the Crazy Fruit Factory and become a fruit-slicing master! Turn sad fruits into delicious desserts in this fun and addictive VR game.

**What are you waiting for? Grab your virtual knife and:**

- **Slice & Dice:** Experience satisfyingly realistic fruit slicing with intuitive VR controls.
- **Go Crazy:** Unleash your inner chef in a hilarious and over-the-top fruit factory.
- **Become a dessert master:** Fulfill endless order
